segments.an8.59:1.1: “Aṭṭhime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa?
segments.an8.59:1.3: Sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno.
segments.an8.59:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
segments.an8.59:2.1: “Cattāro ca paṭipannā, cattāro ca phale ṭhitā;
segments.an8.59:3.3: Karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ, saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalan”ti.

lines: 59-60. Navame dānaṃ dadantānanti dakkhiṇeyyaṃ uddissa dānaṃ dentānaṃ.
Upadhī vipaccanti etena, upadhīsu vā vipaccati, upadhayo vā vipākā etassāti upadhivipākaṃ.
Saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalanti ariyasaṅghe dinnaṃ vipphāraṭṭhānaṃ hoti, vipulaphalanti attho.
